exposure: Major brain injuries in structural brain MRI at term
outcome: Diffusion tensor imaging (DTI) parameters (fractional anisotropy (FA) and mean diffusivity (MD)) at 13 years
cohort: Adolescents born very preterm (gestational age <32 weeks and/or birth weight <=1500 g) between 2004-2006 at Turku University Hospital, Finland.
finding: Adolescents with major brain injuries identified on structural MRI at term exhibited decreased fractional anisotropy and increased mean diffusivity in specific brain regions at 13 years of age, compared to those without major brain injuries.
